favourite.heading: Why New Mexico can pull away
bullets: New Mexico is the better football team by 12.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-12.4 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 2.7 points to New Mexico (-2.7 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours New Mexico by 1.9 points: pass rush vs pass protection (-1.9 pts).

underdog.heading: Why New Mexico State can keep it close
bullets: Playing at New Mexico State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -35.9 to p90 +8.1 for New Mexico State, so a projection of -12.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
